==Runes==
[[File:Rogue Trader - Sudoku.png|alt=The "sudoku" puzzle that must be solved to open the large casket.|thumb|The "sudoku" puzzle that must be solved to open the large casket.]]
'''Items required:''' ''Nothing.''
{{Checklist|1=*Speak to [[Aubury]] at the rune shop in [[Varrock]]. {{Chat option|4Actually, I'm here with a business proposal from Ali Morrisane.}}
*Return to [[Ali Morrisane]] and talk to him.{{Chat option|1I would like to look at your selection of runes.}}
*Open a casket. '''Note:''' You do not have to purchase the unknown runes to unlock them in Ali's store.
**Be aware to fully unlock the store, you must complete BOTH types of caskets at least once.
*If you wish to unlock elemental runes for purchase from Ali, speak to him and open a small casket.  {{Chat option|2Try opening a small casket of runes}}
**For those with high [[Strength]], force open the casket. {{Chat option|1Force box.}}
**For those with high [[Thieving]], pick the lock. {{Chat option|2Pick lock.}}
*If you wish to unlock catalytic runes for purchase from Ali, speak to him and open a large casket. {{Chat option|2Try opening a large casket of runes.|3Examine lock.}}
**You CANNOT force or pick-lock large caskets. When you examine the lock, you will be met with a Sudoku puzzle of runes. No two runes of the same type are allowed in the same row, column, or 3x3 grid. 
**Solve the puzzle, then click on "open casket" when finished. Check the [[Rogue Trader]] in-depth guide for assistance.
***A quick way to solve this puzzle is to assign each different rune a number (i.e. air = 1, water = 2, etc.) and then plug the initial runes into an automatic Sudoku solver. Alternatively, if using RuneLite, use the Runedoku Helper plugin from the Plugin Hub}}
You can return to Ali to unlock more caskets and purchase random amounts of runes at a discount. Viewing the unknown runes before purchase reduces this discount.
